subject: p-fc
title: P.FC.------PHY.U.P.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-16, third of three on book p128, paired with v2-p128-1 and v2-p128-2. Closes Braxton's triple-presentation. (C)P-FC (the concept of particular focus) is crossed with PHY-U-P (physical universe particulars): the question is what particular-focus produces when crossed with physical-universe-particulars — closing the activism-conditions argument by routing through physical-universe ground. PHY-U-P is the partner. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) branches from the main line and carries LANG (language). RT-ALGN (reality alignment) also branches from the main line and carries two chains: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) to INFO-DS (information dissemination), and INTR (interpretation), which carries V-SY (value system) and AF-NT (affinity-nature), with IST-F (isolated focus) on AF-NT.
